_comment: Small sizes for the determinism test, chosen so every Mithril program forks at --threads 4 (MITHRIL_STATS=1 shows waves > 0) while running well under a second. 'sed' applies to every source of the program (main.py, main*.c, rust/src/bin/<name>*.rs); it rewrites the first number on the line marked SIZE. 'expected' is the checksum line every implementation prints at that size, except fsum's c and rust variants (idiomatic reductions, their own bits); fsum's value is the fixed-shape tree sum's (Mithril, c_tree, rust_tree).
